Case reference: 2014001837.CaseDesc: On September 29, 1979 at approximately 8:30 a.m. seven men departed from Anama Bay, Manitoba on a fishing trip. They described the waves as being three to four feet high and they could not see the tree line from where they were. They lost sight of the other two boats and fired shotgun shots into the air hoping for a response. No response was received. Extensive patrols by air, boat and land were made in an attempt to locate the remaining five men. The bodies of Fredrick Ursu and Jerry Hudy were never recovered. They are presumed dead due to drowning.

Case reference: 2014005249.CaseDesc: Peter Cory Butler was reported missing by family on March 24, 2008. He was last seen in downtown Whitecourt, AB on March 15, 2008.

Case reference: 2014004091.CaseDesc: Mark Gibbons was last seen on February 1, 1991, at his home in Calgary, Alberta.  He was reported missing by his family and Mark has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2016030649.CaseDesc: Kean Luo was originally from Malaysia, but relocated to the United States to attend school and begin his career. He relocated to Winnipeg, Manitoba on March 2, 2016, for professional reasons. Concerns were raised by friends and family when Kean was not available to receive calls or messages for an extended period of time. However, on April 2, 2016, police spoke with Kean at a local hotel in Kenora, Ontario. He stated that he was not considering ending his own life, but was experiencing stress and missing his family. His vehicle was subsequently discovered parked on the shoulder of the highway on the Sergeant Thomas Cooper Bridge (Kenora). All mobile phone and banking activity has since ceased.

Case reference: 2026009994.CaseDesc: Kassandra Schoemaker's nephew advised authorities in February 2026 that she hadn't posted online since 2023. An investigation suggested that Kassandra was last seen on November 22, 2023 when she would have left her residence in Victoria County, Nova Scotia. Kassandra is known to be very active on social media but hasn't had any known online presence since. Kassandra has not been in contact with any of her children, her family or friends.

Pierce: Nose, barbell on the bridge of the nose

Case reference: 2015066565.CaseDesc: George Wood was last seen in Surrey BC, on June 20, 2015 by family. At the time George Wood was reported missing, he was unemployed and of no fixed address living on the streets in Burnaby BC. His absence and not keeping in touch with family is out of character.

Belt: Black, Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Black belt with large silver buckle
Scar: Right Arm, Long scar on right arm

Case reference: 2014001333.CaseDesc: On May 18, 1975, members of the Canadian Armed Forces located the personal belongings of William Bereziuk washed up on an island in the Athabasca River 50 km north of Fort McMurray, Alberta. In October 1974, William departed Edmonton with the objective of embarking on a canoe trip along the Athabasca River. He informed his family that he had plans to spend the winter of 1974 in the Birch Mountain area of Alberta and would return to Edmonton in August of 1975.

Jewelry: Metal, Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Crucifix or scapular
Scar: Right Large Toe, Immersion foot (Trench Foot)

Case reference: 2014005606.CaseDesc: Larry Duck of Tadoule Lake was last seen in April of 2011, in Winnipeg, Manitoba. Larry has not made contact with his family since. His whereabouts remain unknown.

Case reference: 2019020557.CaseDesc: On April 20, 2019, at 9:00 pm, Rebecca Dorman was last seen leaving a friend's residence located at the intersection of Mohawk Road East and Upper Wellington Street in Hamilton, Ontario. Rebecca had been staying with her friend, and left the residence without her shoes, purse, phone or keys.

Case reference: 2014003872.CaseDesc: Diane Bélanger was last seen on August 8, 1982, in the Ville-Marie borough of Montreal, Quebec. Diane hasn’t been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2016012267.CaseDesc: On February 28, 2016, Lorlene Bone was last seen at a friend’s residence on the Shoal River Indian Reserve in Manitoba. Lorlene is a mother of four and it is out of character for her not to contact her family.

Tattoo: Left Side Of Neck, Three hearts

Case reference: 2014003550.CaseDesc: Kenneth James Schmit, who went by "Jimmy", was last seen leaving a social gathering at a home in St. Walburg, Saskatchewan at 10:30 p.m. on September 22, 1966. Kenneth was feeling despondent, and, at the time of his disappearance, he sported a heavy beard. Numerous searches of the area were conducted, however, he was not located.

Case reference: 2018005122.CaseDesc: On January 29, 2018, at approximately 6:30 a.m., Balwant Singh was last seen in Toronto, Ontario. Balwant was visiting Canada and failed to board his returning flight on January 29 at 6:00 p.m.

Case reference: 2025008385.CaseDesc: James Davern left his residence on October 2, 2003.  A short time later his vehicle was located abandoned in the area of Niagara Falls State Park, Niagara Falls, New York, U.S.A.  At that time James was feeling despondent.

Case reference: 2018051391.CaseDesc: On September 2, 2018, Himat Singh was last seen at the Ontario Khalsa Darbar Temple in Mississauga, Ontario.  Himat, who was in Canada on a Teaching Visa, packed a bag and was observed entering a vehicle with an unknown individual.

Case reference: 2013000062.CaseDesc: Leonard Pinnock has been missing since March 27, 2011 from Montreal, Quebec. Leonard is originally from Jamaica and he came to visit his family in Montreal but he never made it to the meeting place. Leonard was last seen in the area of Notre-Dame-de-Grâce in Montreal. He travels between Toronto, Ontario, Montreal and Jamaica.
